== Summary ==
[[Karl Koenig]] and [[Kendall Halman]], team tournament champions at the [[2022 U.S. National Championship]].

* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-us-nationals-wrap-olson-repeats/ 2022 US Nationals Wrap: Olson Repeats], starwarsccg.org (20 July 2022). Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2022-us-nationals-wrap-olson-repeats.html swccg.com snapshot]

* '''Photographer:''' Garrett Larson
* '''Identification:''' Wrap-up caption: Koenig and Halman – Team Tournament Champions. [[Karl Koenig]] wears the Ohio HOME shirt; [[Kendall Halman]] wears the Sio Bibble shirt.
